title: Lillekort
world: Old Norway, long ago, in late autumn. Lillekort is born in a tiny, crooked cottage with a sagging turf roof at the edge of a forest of yellow birches and red rowans. Far away, the royal farm stands on a slope above a sandy shore by the open sea: dark log buildings with turf roofs around a long hall, all hung with black cloth at first. Lillekort's sword has a shining golden hilt and hangs in a plain brown leather sheath. His magic ship is a wooden sailing ship with two masts and white sails; when it is small, it is no bigger than a slipper and fits in his pocket. The sea trolls come in black ships with black sails, and their hair is grey. The princess's three secret suits for Lillekort are of gold, silver and brass. The iron chain is huge, heavy and five hundred metres long.
palette: Late autumn on the open coast: crisp, blustery days with yellow birch leaves and scarlet rowan berries whirling over a dark-green sea with white-capped waves. On the three Thursday nights a huge, low, orange harvest moon hangs over the shore and silver sea mist drifts across the sand. The royal farm is draped in black until the wedding, when candlelight makes gold, silver and brass glitter. Under the sea: cool green-blue water and the red-orange glow of the troll's brewing fire.

cast.name: Lillekort
cast.description: En bitte liten gutt som snakker og drar ut i verden samme dag han blir født, og som med list, et tryllesverd og et lommeskip redder to prinsesser.
cast.look: A tiny, bold little boy, no bigger than a four-year-old child, with a round face, rosy cheeks, a small button nose, big bright cornflower-blue eyes, a determined chin and a mop of golden curls. On his head sits an oversized knitted cap with blue-and-white stripes, flopping over one ear. He wears his big brothers' old rags: a huge, faded blue linen smock covered in patches, hanging to his knees like a nightshirt and tied at the waist with a piece of rope, and enormous, floppy old leather boots.
cast.portrait: Background: the autumn forest of yellow birches and red rowans.

cast.name: Lillekort i gulldrakten
cast.description: Lillekort i den blanke gulldrakten som prinsessa trakk på ham mens han sov. Han gjemmer den under fillene sine, så ingen skal se den.
cast.look: The same tiny, bold boy, no bigger than a four-year-old child, with a round face, rosy cheeks, a small button nose, big bright cornflower-blue eyes and a mop of golden curls under his oversized blue-and-white striped knitted cap. Now he wears a shining suit of pure gold that glows in any light: a short gold jacket with round gold buttons and a stiff little collar, gold knee breeches, gold stockings and small gold shoes with gold buckles.
cast.portrait: Background: the candlelit Great Hall of the royal farm.

cast.name: Kong Lavring
cast.description: Lillekorts tvillingbror, den eldste av de to, så lik ham at ingen ser forskjell, og som kommer når Lillekort roper på ham tre ganger.
cast.look: A tiny, bold little boy, no bigger than a four-year-old child, with a round face, rosy cheeks, a small button nose, big bright cornflower-blue eyes and a mop of golden curls, exactly like his twin brother, and a cheeky, know-it-all grin. On his head sits an oversized knitted cap with red-and-white stripes. He wears his big brothers' old rags: a huge, patched mustard-yellow wool smock that hangs down to his knees, tied at the waist with a piece of rope, and big wooden clogs.
cast.portrait: Background: a green meadow with small birds flying up from the trees.

cast.name: Kong Lavring i Lillekorts klær
cast.description: Kong Lavring i gulldrakten og lua til Lillekort. Nå er de to brødrene så like at ingen kan se forskjell på dem.
cast.look: The tiny, bold twin brother dressed in his twin's clothes, so that nobody can tell the two apart: no bigger than a four-year-old child, with a round face, rosy cheeks, a small button nose, big bright cornflower-blue eyes and a mop of golden curls under an oversized blue-and-white striped knitted cap. He wears a shining suit of pure gold: a short gold jacket with round gold buttons and a stiff little collar, gold knee breeches, gold stockings and small gold shoes.
cast.portrait: Background: the candlelit Great Hall of the royal farm.

cast.name: Den yngste prinsessa
cast.description: Kongens yngste datter, som Lillekort redder fra tre troll på stranda, og som modig sier sannheten i sitt eget bryllup.
cast.look: A slim, lively princess of about sixteen with a small, delicate face, a little pointed chin, a tiny snub nose, big grey eyes, pink cheeks and short, tight platinum-blonde curls cropped close like a lamb's fleece. On her curls sits a small gold crown shaped like a ring of oak leaves. She wears an emerald-green velvet dress with puffed shoulders, narrow sleeves and a high round collar embroidered with tiny gold leaves, a thin gold belt, and a string of small white pearls around her neck.
cast.portrait: Background: the shore at dusk with the big flat grey stone by the water.

cast.name: Den eldste prinsessa
cast.description: Kongens eldste datter, som et troll tok med seg ned på havets bunn for lenge siden. Hun ligner lillesøstera si, bare større, og hun er både sterkest og raskest.
cast.look: A tall, strong, broad-shouldered princess of about twenty, a head taller than her little sister and quick on her feet, with the same small, delicate face, pointed chin, tiny snub nose and big grey eyes, pink cheeks and thick platinum-blonde curls that tumble to her shoulders, held back with a string of pearls. She wears a long coral-red wool dress embroidered with little white seashells along the hem, a belt of plaited silver cord, and a silver thimble on one finger.
cast.portrait: Background: the troll's hall under the sea, lit red by the big oven.

cast.name: Ridder Rød
cast.description: En skrytete ridder med rødt skjegg og rød kappe som gjemmer seg i et tre når trollene kommer, og prøver å ta æren for det Lillekort har gjort.
cast.look: A big, burly, barrel-chested knight of about forty, a head taller than most men, with a broad, puffy face that easily turns bright red, a big bulbous nose, small shifty pale-blue eyes under bushy brows, curly red hair and a huge, bushy fiery-red beard. He wears polished steel armour that clanks with every step over a red tunic, a long bright-red cloak and heavy steel-capped boots, and always has a big white handkerchief tucked into his belt.
cast.portrait: Background: the big old oak at the top of the shore.

cast.name: Kjerringa med ett øye
cast.description: Ei lita, gammel kjerring som bare har ett øye og stadig mister det, og som gir Lillekort et sverd, et lommeskip og kunsten å brygge når han finner det.
cast.look: A tiny, very old woman, no taller than a small child, so bent that her back is curved like a hook, with a small, deeply wrinkled face like a walnut, a flat little nose, a wide toothless grin and only one eye: a single round, shiny sky-blue eye in the middle of her forehead, which easily pops out like a marble. Her thin white hair is in a tiny knot. She wears a long faded-lavender dress and a big brown fringed shawl, and leans on a crooked stick.
cast.portrait: Background: the autumn forest with yellow and red leaves.

cast.name: Kongen
cast.description: Kongen på kongsgården ved havet, far til to prinsesser. Han er glad og snill, og han ler så han må holde seg på magen.
cast.look: A jolly, stocky king of about sixty with a big round belly, a broad, ruddy face made for laughing, a bulbous nose, crinkly brown eyes, bushy chestnut-brown eyebrows, thick chestnut curls and a big, round, curly chestnut-brown beard clipped short like a bush. On his head sits a tall gold crown with seven points, each tipped with a round amber bead. He wears a long rust-orange velvet robe with a wide brown fur collar, a gold belt and soft brown boots.
cast.portrait: Background: the garden of the royal farm with apple trees in autumn colours.

cast.name: Kokkejenta
cast.description: Den travle kokkejenta på kongsgården, som Lillekort bærer ved og vann for, og som får gullbånd og sølvbånd i stedet for ved.
cast.look: A tall, gangly kitchen maid of about eighteen with long arms, a long, cheerful face, a big crooked smile, a long nose with a dab of flour on the tip, lively hazel eyes and one thick sandy-blonde braid hanging down her back. Her sleeves are rolled up. She wears a long violet wool dress and a big white apron with soup stains, and keeps a large wooden ladle tucked into her apron strings.
cast.portrait: Background: the warm kitchen of the royal farm, with copper pots and a big hearth.

cast.name: Trollet med fem hoder
cast.description: Det første trollet som kommer opp av havet for å hente prinsessa. Det er så stort at det skygger for månen.
cast.look: A huge, hunched sea troll five times as tall as a man, with dusky purple-grey skin like a mussel shell and a round hump of a back like an upturned boat, crusted with barnacles and seaweed. Exactly five heads poke out in a row from under the front of the hump, like turtles peeping out of a shell, each with a long drooping nose, small round yellow eyes and shaggy grey hair. It has long, dangling arms, flat flipper feet and an old fishing net knotted round its middle.
cast.portrait: Background: the moonlit sea and a black ship with black sails.

cast.name: Trollet med ti hoder
cast.description: Det andre trollet, som kommer den neste torsdagen. Det er dobbelt så stort som det første.
cast.look: An enormous sea troll about ten times as tall as a man, with rough, slate-blue skin, knobbly and shiny like wet rock, a broad, square body, short thick legs and huge webbed feet. It has exactly ten round heads in two neat rows of five, one row stacked above the other like eggs in a box; each head has a flat nose, big goggling green eyes, a wide frog mouth and a scraggly grey beard. It wears a torn black sail wrapped around its middle.
cast.portrait: Background: the night sea with drifting silver sea mist.

cast.name: Trollet med femten hoder
cast.description: Det tredje og største trollet av alle, så stort at det stenger for hele himmelen.
cast.look: The biggest troll of all, as big as a mountain, with dark peat-brown, lumpy skin like a bog, shaggy grey hair on its shoulders, a round belly and legs like old tree stumps. It has exactly fifteen heads stacked in a pyramid: five on its shoulders, then four, three, two and one on top; each head has a round red nose, small blinking amber eyes and a shock of grey hair. It wears a huge patched brown sailcloth tunic tied with a ship's rope.
cast.portrait: Background: a huge orange moon behind dark clouds over the sea.

cast.name: Trollet på havets bunn
cast.description: Trollet som bor i et fjell på havets bunn og har holdt den eldste prinsessa fanget. Det brøler før det tenker, men er lett å lure.
cast.look: A fat, grumpy troll about three times as tall as a man, with smooth, shiny turquoise skin like a wet fish, a barrel belly, short bowed legs and big flat webbed feet. He has one huge head with a gigantic, wrinkly, trumpet-shaped nose that is always sniffing, bulging pale-orange eyes, bristly orange eyebrows and a long tangle of brown kelp for hair and beard. He wears baggy patched sailcloth breeches held up by a rope and a necklace of big shells.
cast.portrait: Background: the troll's hall under the sea, lit red by the big oven.

places.name: the Shore
places.look: A wide, pale sandy beach below the royal farm, curving along the open sea. Right at the water's edge lies one big, flat, grey boulder, and at the top of the beach stands a huge, gnarled old oak with wide, spreading branches and yellow-brown autumn leaves. Tufts of beach grass grow in the low dunes, and a grassy slope rises behind to the dark log buildings of the royal farm.

places.name: the Great Hall
places.look: A long, high hall of dark honey-brown logs with carved pillars, rosemaling on the ceiling beams, small-paned windows along one side and a big stone fireplace at the far end. One very long plank table with benches runs down the middle, with a tall carved chair for the king at its head. Iron candle-crowns hang from the beams, and for the weddings, garlands of autumn leaves and flowers and many tall candles decorate the walls.

places.name: the Hall under the Sea
places.look: A vast, rough cave hall inside a rock mountain at the bottom of the sea, with dark blue-grey rock walls decorated with shells, starfish and seaweed, and a smooth stone floor. A huge stone oven glows red and orange at one end, with enormous wooden brewing vats and barrels beside it. A tall, dark wooden cupboard stands against one wall, and a heavy round wooden door leads out into the green-blue sea.

cover.prompt: On the Shore at night under a huge orange moon, tiny Lillekort stands in the foreground on the sand with his feet apart and his hands on his hips, grinning up fearlessly, the golden hilt of his sword glinting at his belt and his tiny ship peeking out of his pocket. Behind him, the enormous Five-Headed Troll wades out of the foaming sea, all five heads peering down at him in surprise. In the big oak at the side, Sir Red hides among the leaves with only his eyes showing.
cover.caption: Lillekort er bitte liten, men han er lur, og han er ikke det minste redd.
cover.alt: Lille Lillekort står med hendene i siden på en strand i måneskinn. Bak ham vasser et digert troll med fem hoder opp av havet, og Ridder Rød gjemmer seg i et stort tre.

illustrations.anchor: Men han maste og maste, han også.
illustrations.prompt: Outside a tiny, crooked cottage with a sagging turf roof at the edge of an autumn forest, Lillekort strolls out of the door and down the path, chin up and happy as a lark, a little lunch bundle tied to a stick over his shoulder. In the doorway behind him his mother, a thin, tired woman in a grey dress and a brown headscarf, throws up her hands in astonishment, and seven older children crowd around her skirts, staring. Far down the road ahead, tiny Lavring is just trotting round a bend. Soft morning light.
illustrations.caption: «Du er jo enda mindre!» sa mora. Men ut døra spaserte han, han også.
illustrations.alt: En bitte liten gutt i altfor store filler spaserer ut av et lite hus med torvtak, med matpakke på en pinne. I døra står mora og mange søsken og måper. Langt borte på veien går tvillingbroren.

illustrations.anchor: Så døpte de hverandre med litt vann fra bekken.
illustrations.prompt: Low, close view beside a small, clear brook in the autumn forest: Lillekort and Lavring stand on two flat stones facing each other, each solemnly pouring a handful of water over the other's golden curls, their big striped caps held in their free hands. Water drops sparkle in the sun, and both boys squeeze their eyes shut and giggle. Their two little lunch bundles lie open on the moss beside the brook, with a few bread crusts left, and yellow and red leaves float past on the water.
illustrations.caption: Plask og plask! Nå heter de Lillekort og Kong Lavring.
illustrations.alt: To bitte små tvillinggutter står på hver sin stein i en bekk og heller vann over hodet på hverandre. Begge ler med øynene igjen, og gule og røde blader flyter forbi.

illustrations.anchor: Lillekort så seg om.
illustrations.prompt: Close, low view in the autumn forest: among yellow and red leaves and grey stones, the One-Eyed Old Woman gropes about, bent double, patting the ground with both hands, the single eyelid in the middle of her forehead shut. Right beside her shoe lies her eye, a shiny sky-blue ball like a marble, gazing up at Lillekort. Lillekort crouches with his hands on his knees and stares back at it, his mouth a little round O of surprise. Dappled golden light falls through the trees.
illustrations.caption: Ved skoen hennes lå det noe rundt og blankt. Det var øyet!
illustrations.alt: Ei lita, krumbøyd kjerring famler rundt blant gule og røde blader. Ved skoen hennes ligger et blankt, blått øye som ligner en klinkekule, og Lillekort sitter på huk og ser forbauset på det.

illustrations.anchor: Kjerringa lo så det knirket i henne.
illustrations.prompt: In the autumn forest, the One-Eyed Old Woman laughs so hard that she creaks, her single eyelid still shut, and pulls a short sword with a shining golden hilt out from under her brown fringed shawl, holding it out flat across both palms. Lillekort stands in front of her, holding her shiny blue eye up high between his finger and thumb, one eyebrow raised like a shrewd little trader. Yellow leaves drift down around them. Medium view.
illustrations.caption: «Du er en luring, du», sa kjerringa, og dro fram et sverd med gullhåndtak.
illustrations.alt: Den lille kjerringa ler og drar et sverd med blankt gullhåndtak fram under sjalet. Lillekort står foran henne og holder øyet hennes høyt opp mellom to fingre.

illustrations.anchor: Og hva fikk han?
illustrations.prompt: Deeper in the autumn forest, beside a mossy tussock, a second One-Eyed Old Woman, exactly like the first, presses her shiny blue eye back into place in the middle of her forehead and beams. Lillekort, the golden-hilted sword now hanging at his belt, holds up a tiny wooden ship with white sails between his finger and thumb and squints at it doubtfully; it is no bigger than a slipper. Close view in soft green-gold forest light.
illustrations.caption: Et skip så lite at det fikk plass i lomma! Plopp! Og kjerringa kunne se igjen.
illustrations.alt: Ei ny, lita kjerring trykker øyet sitt på plass midt i panna og smiler. Lillekort, med sverdet i beltet, holder opp et bitte lite skip med hvite seil og ser tvilende på det.

illustrations.anchor: Da Lillekort kom ut av skogen, ville han prøve skipet.
illustrations.prompt: At the edge of the forest, beside a little brook in tall autumn grass, Lillekort has set his tiny ship down in the grass and stands with one foot inside it and the other foot lifted, wobbling with his arms out, eyes wide with delight. The ship is growing under him: it is already as big as a rowing boat and still swelling, its two masts shooting up and its white sails unfurling, with a shimmer of magic around the hull. Bright, windy afternoon, yellow and red leaves blowing.
illustrations.caption: Lillekort satte den ene foten oppi, og da vokste skipet!
illustrations.alt: Lillekort står med den ene foten i det lille skipet sitt ved en bekk. Skipet vokser og vokser, og master og hvite seil skyter opp rundt ham.

illustrations.anchor: På kongsgården sto folk i vinduene og måpte.
illustrations.prompt: Wide view: above the royal farm on its slope over the sea, Lillekort's big wooden ship with two masts and full white sails glides through the air like a bird, with Lillekort waving from the bow. Every log building below is hung with black cloth, and black curtains flap at the windows, where people lean out, gaping and pointing: the King at the biggest window and six servants at the others. Four more people run down the path to the sandy shore. Clear, windy autumn day.
illustrations.caption: Et skip som seilte i lufta! Alle på kongsgården sto og måpte.
illustrations.alt: Et stort skip med hvite seil flyr gjennom lufta over kongsgården, der alt er dekket med svart stoff. Lillekort vinker fra baugen, og kongen og folk i vinduene gaper og peker.

illustrations.anchor: Torsdag kveld fulgte Ridder Rød prinsessa ned til stranda.
illustrations.prompt: Evening on the Shore under a big, low, orange moon. The Youngest Princess sits on the big flat grey stone at the water's edge, hugging her knees and trembling, and looks back over her shoulder with one hand reaching out. Behind her, Sir Red, his armour clanking, scrambles up the huge old oak as fast as he can, his red cloak snagged on a branch and one boot kicking, glancing nervously out to sea. Sea mist drifts over the sand.
illustrations.caption: Ridder Rød så seg rundt. Så klatret han opp i et stort tre.
illustrations.alt: Prinsessa sitter på en stein ved vannet og skjelver i kveldslyset. Bak henne klatrer Ridder Rød i rustning og rød kappe opp i et stort tre så fort han kan.

illustrations.anchor: Akkurat da han kom ned til stranda, begynte det å suse og bruse ute på havet.
illustrations.prompt: Night on the Shore. The Five-Headed Troll wades out of a black ship with black sails through foaming waves, so huge that its barnacled hump blots out the big orange moon, and all five heads peer down curiously. Tiny Lillekort has just run onto the sand, the golden hilt of his sword glinting at his belt; he plants his feet and looks up with a bold grin. The Youngest Princess clings to her stone, and high in the oak Sir Red's wide eyes peek out between the leaves.
illustrations.caption: Ut av det svarte skipet vasset trollet. Og det hadde fem hoder!
illustrations.alt: Et digert troll med fem hoder vasser i land fra et svart skip, så stort at det skygger for månen. Lillekort står modig i sanden, prinsessa holder seg fast i steinen, og Ridder Rød kikker ut fra treet.

illustrations.anchor: «Hvil deg litt på fanget mitt», sa prinsessa.
illustrations.prompt: Late at night on the Shore, in soft orange moonlight and silver sea mist, the Youngest Princess sits on the big flat stone with Lillekort fast asleep on her lap, his mouth open and his striped cap slipping over one eye. Smiling to herself, she carefully pulls a shining golden jacket onto him; golden breeches already cover his legs, and his rags lie folded beside her. In the background, the empty black troll ship rocks at the water's edge. Close, cosy view.
illustrations.caption: Mens Lillekort sov, trakk prinsessa en drakt av gull på ham.
illustrations.alt: Lillekort sover på fanget til prinsessa i måneskinnet. Hun smiler og trekker forsiktig en skinnende gulljakke på ham, mens det svarte trollskipet gynger tomt i vannkanten.

illustrations.anchor: I sanden lå en dott med grått trollhår.
illustrations.prompt: In misty moonlight on the Shore, Sir Red, back down from the oak and puffed up with pride, bends over and pinches a tuft of grey troll hair out of the sand, about to wrap it in his big white handkerchief, with a sly grin. The Youngest Princess stands a little way off with her hands clasped and a worried face. Far behind them at the water's edge, Lillekort, in his rags again, peeks over the side of the black troll ship with his arms full of gold and silver ribbons.
illustrations.caption: I sanden lå en dott med grått trollhår. Den stakk Ridder Rød i lommetørkleet.
illustrations.alt: Ridder Rød bøyer seg ned i sanden og plukker opp en dott grått trollhår med et lurt glis. Prinsessa står bekymret ved siden av. Langt bak kikker Lillekort opp fra trollskipet med armene fulle av gullbånd.

illustrations.anchor: Det andre trollet var dobbelt så stort som det første.
illustrations.prompt: Seen from low down behind Lillekort's back on the Shore: the Ten-Headed Troll towers over the beach in the moonlit mist, twice as big as the first troll, water streaming from its webbed feet, and all ten of its heads, in two rows of five, bend down together to stare at the tiny boy. Lillekort stands with his hands on his hips, not scared at all. On the flat stone the Youngest Princess covers her mouth, and up in the oak Sir Red hugs the trunk with his eyes squeezed shut.
illustrations.caption: Det andre trollet var dobbelt så stort som det første. Og det hadde ti hoder!
illustrations.alt: Et kjempestort troll med ti hoder i to rader bøyer seg ned og glor på Lillekort, som står med hendene i siden. Prinsessa holder seg for munnen, og Ridder Rød klamrer seg til treet med øynene igjen.

illustrations.anchor: Lillekort kom hjem med et nytt fang gullbånd og sølvbånd.
illustrations.prompt: In the warm, busy kitchen of the royal farm, lit by a big hearth fire, Lillekort trots in through the door with his arms piled so high with shining gold and silver ribbons that only his striped cap shows above them. The Cook Maid, stirring a big pot, turns and throws up her ladle in surprise. Gold and silver ribbons from last time already hang everywhere: tied around the copper pots, looped over the shelves and wound around the broom. The wood basket by the hearth is empty.
illustrations.caption: Et nytt fang gullbånd og sølvbånd! Men det var fortsatt ikke ved.
illustrations.alt: Lillekort kommer inn på kjøkkenet med armene fulle av skinnende gullbånd og sølvbånd. Kokkejenta snur seg forbauset med sleiva i været, og overalt henger det bånd fra forrige gang.

illustrations.anchor: «JEG SKAL LÆRE DEG!» brølte alle de femten hodene på én gang.
illustrations.prompt: Very wide view of the Shore at night: the Fifteen-Headed Troll is so enormous that it blocks out the whole sky, and all fifteen heads in its pyramid bellow at once, eyes squeezed shut and mouths wide open, more silly than scary. The gust blows the sea mist flat and bends the big oak, where Sir Red clings to a branch like a wet cat, and whips the Youngest Princess's curls as she crouches on her stone. Tiny Lillekort leans into the wind, holding his striped cap on, and grins.
illustrations.caption: «JEG SKAL LÆRE DEG!» brølte alle de femten hodene på én gang.
illustrations.alt: Et troll som er så stort at det stenger for hele himmelen, brøler med alle de femten hodene sine. Ridder Rød klamrer seg til en grein, prinsessa huker seg ned på steinen, og lille Lillekort holder på lua og gliser.

illustrations.anchor: Prinsessa klemte Lillekort så hardt at han nesten ikke fikk puste.
illustrations.prompt: Close, warm view on the Shore after the last troll is gone: the Youngest Princess kneels in the sand and hugs Lillekort so tightly that his cheeks squash, his eyes bulge and his striped cap pops off his head. Behind them, fifteen small, round puffs of smoke float away one after another over the moonlit sea into the mist. In the background, Sir Red is still hanging in the oak, shaking.
illustrations.caption: Prinsessa klemte Lillekort så hardt at han nesten ikke fikk puste.
illustrations.alt: Prinsessa sitter på kne i sanden og klemmer Lillekort så hardt at lua spretter av. Bak dem driver femten små røykskyer ut over havet, og Ridder Rød henger fortsatt skjelvende i treet.

illustrations.anchor: Men prinsessa ville ha ham og ingen andre.
illustrations.prompt: The wedding day in the Great Hall, decorated with garlands of autumn leaves and flowers and dozens of tall candles. At the long table sit the King at the head, the Youngest Princess in a white bridal veil, and Sir Red beside her, stroking his red beard smugly. Six wedding guests turn their heads as Lillekort comes in through the door in his sooty rags, carrying a big pewter jug in both arms and looking perfectly innocent. Warm golden candlelight.
illustrations.caption: Prinsessa ville ha ham og ingen andre. Så Lillekort kom inn med kanna.
illustrations.alt: I den pyntede salen sitter kongen, prinsessa og Ridder Rød ved langbordet sammen med gjestene. Lillekort kommer inn døra i sotete filler med en stor kanne i armene.

illustrations.anchor: Ridder Rød ble så sint at han ble rød som en tomat.
illustrations.prompt: In the candlelit Great Hall, Lillekort in Gold stands beside the long table, shining so brightly that golden light fills the whole hall, the pewter jug still in his hands. A silver suit, a brass suit and his old rags lie in a heap around his feet. Sir Red, red as a tomato, gapes with his mouth hanging open. The Youngest Princess rises from her chair, beaming, and the King and six guests stare with huge eyes.
illustrations.caption: DASK! Der sto Lillekort i gull, så blank at hele salen lyste.
illustrations.alt: Lillekort står i en skinnende gulldrakt, så blank at hele salen lyser. Rundt føttene hans ligger en sølvdrakt, en messingdrakt og fillene. Ridder Rød er rød som en tomat, og alle ved bordet glor.

illustrations.anchor: Kongen kikket på trollhåret.
illustrations.prompt: At the long table in the Great Hall, the King pinches his nose and peers at three tufts of grey troll hair on Sir Red's unfolded white handkerchief, while his eyes already slide sideways to a glittering heap of gold, silver and jewels piled so high that the table sags under it. Sir Red sweats and tugs at his collar. Lillekort in Gold stands proudly beside the treasure with his hands on his hips. Warm candlelight.
illustrations.caption: Kongen kikket på trollhåret. Så kikket han på gullet.
illustrations.alt: Kongen holder seg for nesa og ser på tre dotter grått trollhår på lommetørkleet til Ridder Rød. Ved siden av ligger en diger haug med gull, sølv og edelsteiner, og Lillekort i gulldrakt står stolt ved den.

illustrations.anchor: Kongen lo så han måtte holde seg på magen.
illustrations.prompt: In the autumn garden of the royal farm, among apple trees full of red apples and paths covered in yellow leaves, the King doubles over with laughter, holding his big belly with both hands, his crown wobbling and tears of laughter in his eyes. In front of him, Lillekort in Gold holds up the tiny wooden ship with white sails on the palm of his hand, completely serious. Bright, crisp afternoon light.
illustrations.caption: «Jeg har skip selv», sa Lillekort. Og kongen lo så han måtte holde seg på magen.
illustrations.alt: Kongen står i hagen og ler så han må holde seg på magen. Foran ham holder Lillekort i gulldrakt opp et bitte lite skip med hvite seil i håndflata, helt alvorlig.

illustrations.anchor: Da tok Lillekort selv tak i enden og la det første leddet oppi.
illustrations.prompt: On a long wooden jetty, a huge crowd of sailors stretches back out of sight, and the eight in front scratch their heads. Lillekort in Gold drags the end of an enormous, heavy iron chain and drops the first link into his little ship, which bobs in the water beside the jetty. With a clink the ship is growing: it is already bigger than a rowing boat, its masts shooting up, while the rest of the chain lies coiled in a mountain behind him. Sunny morning, sparkling sea.
illustrations.caption: Klirr! Lillekort la det første leddet oppi, og skipet vokste.
illustrations.alt: På brygga står en stor flokk menn og klør seg i hodet. Lillekort i gulldrakt legger det første leddet av en diger jernkjetting oppi det lille skipet sitt, og skipet begynner å vokse.

illustrations.anchor: Der inne satt ei prinsesse og sydde.
illustrations.prompt: In the Hall under the Sea, beside the glowing oven, the Eldest Princess sits on a big stool sewing a long piece of cloth. She has just looked up and dropped her needle, which dangles on its thread, her mouth open in amazement. In the round doorway stands Lillekort in Gold, dripping wet, with a strand of seaweed on his cap and the end of the huge iron chain tied around his tummy, trailing out through the door behind him. Two little fish peek in after him.
illustrations.caption: Der inne satt ei prinsesse og sydde. Hun slapp nåla da hun så Lillekort.
illustrations.alt: Inne i et fjell på havets bunn sitter en stor prinsesse og syr. Hun slipper nåla forbauset, for i døra står Lillekort i gulldrakt, dryppvåt, med en lang jernkjetting rundt magen.

illustrations.anchor: «Snuff, snuff», sa trollet.
illustrations.prompt: In the red-lit Hall under the Sea, the Sea Troll stands in the middle of the floor with his head thrown back, his huge nose twitching as he sniffs the air, eyes narrowed suspiciously. The Eldest Princess stands in front of the tall wooden cupboard with her hands behind her back, smiling innocently. Through a crack in the cupboard door, Lillekort in Gold peeks out with one eye, trying very hard not to sneeze.
illustrations.caption: «Snuff, snuff! Huff! Det lukter menneske her!»
illustrations.alt: Sjøtrollet står midt i fjellhallen og snuser med den store nesa si. Prinsessa står foran et høyt skap og smiler uskyldig, og gjennom en sprekk i skapdøra kikker Lillekort ut.

illustrations.anchor: Så begynte han å brygge.
illustrations.prompt: The Hall under the Sea glows red from the fire in the huge stone oven. Lillekort in Gold stands on top of a barrel, stirring a gigantic steaming brewing vat with a long wooden paddle and pointing bossily with his other hand. Twelve trolls of all shapes, sizes and colours, fat and thin, with long noses and short, stagger in carrying buckets of water, while the Sea Troll waves his arms and bellows at them to hurry. Steam and bubbles rise everywhere.
illustrations.caption: Lillekort rørte og rørte. «Jeg trenger flere til å bære vann!»
illustrations.alt: Lillekort i gulldrakt står på en tønne og rører i et kjempestort bryggekar mens det damper. Tolv troll bærer bøtter med vann, og sjøtrollet vifter med armene og brøler at de må skynde seg.

illustrations.anchor: De andre trollene drakk, de også.
illustrations.prompt: In the Hall under the Sea, the Sea Troll lies snoring on his back on the stone floor, a giant drinking horn still in his hand. Around him, twelve other trolls yawn enormous yawns and flop down one after another, some already asleep in a heap. Lillekort in Gold leans on his stirring paddle and grins, and the Eldest Princess, pressed against the wall, lets out her breath in relief. Behind the big oven, one little, wrinkly old troll hag with a grey bun peeks out, still wide awake.
illustrations.caption: Gjesp! Bums! Gjesp! Bums! Ett etter ett sovnet trollene.
illustrations.alt: Sjøtrollet ligger og snorker på steingulvet, og rundt ham gjesper de andre trollene og faller om ett etter ett. Lillekort gliser, prinsessa puster lettet ut, og bak ovnen titter ei lita trollkjerring fram.

illustrations.anchor: «Alle som én!» ropte de fem hundre mennene oppe på skipet.
illustrations.prompt: Seen from the side at the surface of the sea: on the deck of the big magic ship with white sails, a long row of sailors hauls on the iron chain together, the row stretching out of sight, and the six nearest lean back with red faces. Up out of the glittering water on the end of the chain rise Lillekort in Gold, the Eldest Princess and a big wooden chest overflowing with gold and silver, all tied together and dripping, into bright sunshine. The princess laughs and holds on tight.
illustrations.caption: «Alle som én!» Og så halte de. Opp, opp, opp, helt opp i sola.
illustrations.alt: Sjømenn på et stort skip drar i en jernkjetting. Opp av havet kommer Lillekort, den store prinsessa og ei kiste full av gull og sølv, bundet sammen og dryppvåte, rett opp i sola.

illustrations.anchor: «Jeg sa du bare skulle rope hvis du var i skikkelig trøbbel», sa Kong Lavring.
illustrations.prompt: On a wide green meadow with autumn-coloured trees at its edge, Lavring stands with his arms crossed and a grumpy frown, having just given his twin a push. Lillekort in Gold goes rolling head over heels across the grass like a shiny golden ball, his striped cap flying off, grass and leaves whirling up around him. A flock of small birds still circles above the trees. Bright, breezy afternoon.
illustrations.caption: Kong Lavring ga Lillekort en dytt, så han trillet rundt og rundt bortover enga.
illustrations.alt: På ei grønn eng står Kong Lavring med armene i kors. Lillekort i gulldrakt triller rundt og rundt bortover graset som en skinnende gullball, og lua hans flyr av.

illustrations.anchor: «Lillekort!» ropte begge prinsessene, og løp mot ham.
illustrations.prompt: In the Great Hall, Lavring in Gold, dressed in his twin brother's clothes and looking exactly like him, stands in the middle of the floor. The Eldest Princess, the fastest, has reached him first: she sweeps him off his feet in a big hug and plants a loud kiss on his cheek, his legs dangling. Behind her, the Youngest Princess, pushed aside, stumbles to a halt with her arms flung out and her mouth open. Bright daylight through the small-paned windows.
illustrations.caption: Men storesøstera var raskest. Smask!
illustrations.alt: Den store prinsessa løfter Kong Lavring, kledd i klærne til Lillekort, opp i en stor klem og kysser ham på kinnet. Bak henne står lillesøstera, som ble dyttet til side, og gaper.

illustrations.anchor: Så ble det bryllup.
illustrations.prompt: A double wedding in the Great Hall, decorated with garlands and candles. In the middle, two tiny bridegrooms who look exactly alike dance hand in hand with their brides: Lillekort in Gold with the Youngest Princess, and Lavring in Gold with the Eldest Princess, both brides in white veils. The King dances a jig beside them, and the Cook Maid carries in a towering cake. In the background, Sir Red trudges past the door with an armful of firewood. Eight guests clap and sing.
illustrations.caption: To bryllup på én gang! Det hørtes over sju kongeriker.
illustrations.alt: I den pyntede salen danser to like små brudgommer i gull med hver sin prinsesse. Kongen danser, kokkejenta bærer inn en høy kake, og i døra går Ridder Rød forbi med et fang ved.
